deg_counts.definition: padj < 0.05 AND |log2FC| >= 2.0 in any declared contrast (ADR 0071 pass-any), direction carried from the winning contrast

cross_check.reading: the deposited TPM and raw counts agree on the sample profiles (rank correlation near 1)

tpm.used_for: cross-check only; the DEG input is the raw counts, because the count model is the documented one

method.filter: edgeR filterByExpr rule written out in the live worker
method.model: limma-voom (voom's own library-size normalisation, moderated t)

model_system: human right-atrial-appendage whole-tissue bulk RNA-seq (not cardiomyocyte-specific)
null_outcome_statement: no gene reaches padj < 0.05 in any declared staged contrast under the live implementation; the item publishes the honest zero (no threshold loosening, no padj-only counting, no arm selection by outcome)

samples.match_basis: patient number in the matrix column header joined to the title

audit_model_alternative_edger_ql.method: edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test with TMM on the same filtered matrix (the pre-existing audit environment has edgeR; the live worker does not)
audit_model_alternative_edger_ql.reading: a liberal alternative test finds at most two marginal genes, all in the post-operative arm; not published

pooled_AF_vs_SR.contrast: AF-SR with the three AF arms pooled (18 vs 9), separate fit
pooled_AF_vs_SR.note: the staged design is the declared one; pooling does not change the conclusion

series.arm_prose_discrepancy: the pre-existing AF audit recorded SR 10 / post-operative AF 7; the deposited series matrix says SR 9 / post-operative AF 8, and this item follows the deposit
series.assay: bulk RNA-seq, unique exon-mapped reads (featureCounts), GRCh38
series.column_join: the matrix columns are patient numbers; they are joined to the series titles by `patient nr. N` and verified with the sex probes

sex_label_verification.method: per-column sex from the XIST / (RPS4Y1, DDX3Y, UTY, KDM5D) log2(CPM+1) contrast; a female profile has XIST > 3 and Y < 4
sex_label_verification.reading: 26/27 agree, so the patient-number column labels are sound; the one discordance is an annotated-female column whose expression is male (recorded, not corrected: sex is not a design factor here)

arms.persistent AF: AF present continuously (>7 days in the source cohort description); the persistent arm
arms.post-operative AF: AF arising after cardiac surgery; kept as its own declared arm, not merged into the persistent group

staging.decision: the three AF arms are declared as separate contrasts against the sinus-rhythm arm inside one joint fit, so the staging is carried rather than averaged into a single case group
staging.pooled_sensitivity: all 18 AF libraries vs 9 sinus rhythm, measured separately

series.tissue: human right atrial appendage biopsy (whole tissue)
